camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi UpdateSubs700 --region cn-hangzhou --PoolKey 'FC10000016848****' --TelX '700********0000' --OperateType updateNoA --SubsId 1000000000 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the binding relationship of a 700 number
name: UpdateSubs700

parameters.help_en: The key of the number pool
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
updateNoA: Updates Number A.
updateNoB: Updates Number B.
updateExpire: Updates the validity period of the binding relationship.
updateGroup: Updates the Number G group.
updateNoDefaultA: Updates the default callback Number A in GXB mode.
updateCallRestrict: Sets the single-call restriction.
updateOutId: Updates the OutId field.
updateIsRecordingEnabled: Updates the recording status in the binding.
updateAsr: Updates the ASR status in the binding.
updateAudio: Updates the ringtone configuration in the binding
parameters.help_zh:
updateNoA：修改 A 号码。
updateNoB：修改 B 号码。
updateExpire：修改绑定关系有效期。
updateGroup：修改 G 号码组。
updateNoDefaultA：GXB模式中修改默认回呼叫A号码。
updateCallRestrict：设置单通呼叫限制。
updateOutId：更新 OutId 字段。
updateIsRecordingEnabled：更新绑定中录音状态。
updateAsr：更新绑定中 ASR 状态。
updateAudio：更新绑定铃音配置
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the binding relationship, which uniquely identifies the number binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 绑定关系ID，用于唯一识别号码绑定关系
parameters.name: subs_id

parameters.help_en: The intermediate Number X. If the business user does not specify Number X, the application platform assigns a number from the number pool as Number X
parameters.help_zh: 中间号X。业务使用方未指定X号码时，由应用平台从号码池中指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: The order ID. This parameter is required in practice. Encrypt the order ID for reporting to the regulatory platform
parameters.help_zh: 订单 ID(实际上必填， 建议客户进行订单号加密，用于报送监管平台)
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. The Industrial Internet identification code, which has a one-to-one mapping with the OrderId. The code supports characters such as periods (.) and forward slashes (/) to separate code domains. The code must not contain non-printable characters, such as spaces and line breaks. This field is required when the business user generates the Industrial Internet identification code
parameters.help_zh:
可选工业互联网标识编码，与OrderID保持一一对应关系。编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。
当业务使用方自行生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选
parameters.name: industrial_id

parameters.help_en: The new Number A in the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改绑定关系中的A号码
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en: The default Number A for the GXB private number. Note: The callback mode can be set at the number pool level. When the callback mode is set to the default mode, this field takes effect. When Number B calls Number X, the call is forwarded to this Number A by default. If Number A is not set, the call cannot be connected. To update Number A, call the number binding modification API
parameters.help_zh:
A号码
GXB 隐私号的 DefaultA号码。
说明
支持在号池维度设置回拨模式，当回拨模式为默认模式时，此字段生效，即 B 号码拨打 X 号码时，默认会转接到 此 A 号码，如 A 号码未设置，则无法接通。
如需更新 A 号码，请调用 号码绑定修改接口
parameters.name: defaulta

parameters.help_en: The new Number B in the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改绑定关系中的B号码
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en: The new group ID in the binding relationship
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The new expiration time of the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改绑定关系的有效时间
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_zh: 修改单通呼叫限制逻辑
parameters.name: call_restrict

parameters.help_en: The new media selection in the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改中绑定关系中的媒体选择
parameters.name: need_record

parameters.help_en:
Optional. The audio playback code.
AXB mode:
ACallX_Apre: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number A before the call is connected when Number A calls Number X.
ACallX_Ain: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number A after the call is connected when Number A calls Number X.
ACallX_Bin: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number B after the call is connected when Number A calls Number X.
BCallX_Bpre: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number B before the call is connected when Number B calls Number X.
BCallX_Ain: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number A after the call is connected when Number B calls Number X.
BCallX_Bin: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number B after the call is connected when Number B calls Number X.
GXB mode:
GCallX_Gpre: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to the caller before the call is connected when a number in Group G calls Number X.
GCallX_Gin: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to the caller after the call is connected when a number in Group G calls Number X.
GCallX_Bin: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number B after the call is connected when a number in Group G calls Number X.
BCallX_Bpre: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number B before the call is connected when Number B calls Number X.
BCallX_Gin: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to the callee after the call is connected when Number B calls Number X.
BCallX_Bin: The audio playback code for the voice prompt played to Number B after the call is connected when Number B calls Number X
parameters.help_zh:
可选放音编码
AXB模式

ACallX_ApreA呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

ACallX_AinA呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

ACallX_BinA呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_BpreB呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_Ain B呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_Bin      B呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

GXB模式

GCallX_Gpre号码组G中的号码呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向主叫播放的语音提示放音编码。

GCallX_Gin号码组G中的号码呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向主叫播放的语音提示放音编码。

GCallX_Bin号码组G中的号码呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_BpreB呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_Gin呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向被叫播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_BinB呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码
parameters.name: audio
